name: URDP
subtitle: Universal Robotics Development Platform
summary: One connected robot model for mechanical design, electronics, software, simulation, deployment, and runtime monitoring.
overview: URDP is a proposed engineering platform built around a shared model of the complete robot. It aims to connect existing tools and track the relationships between parts, wiring, firmware, AI models, simulation, and documentation.
current_state: The supplied work defines the platform architecture and proposed first-version scope. It does not establish a completed application or working integrations.
highlights: URDP Studio: a desktop workspace for the robot engineering lifecycle.
The .urdp project format: a portable package for the robot model and related engineering information.
URTP Runtime: a proposed onboard runtime for deployment, telemetry, diagnostics, and replay.
next_focus: Define a minimal robot knowledge model, component relationships, and a small end-to-end project workflow before expanding integrations.
